senses.gloss:
Kahola
------------------------------------------
Kahola was a disciple of the sage उद्दालक. Later, he married Sujātā, उद्दालक’s daughter and got अष्टावक्र as his son. (See also AṢṬĀVAKRA.)
He once visited the court of the king जनक and was defeated by the sage Bandi in a philosophical disputation. Consequently he had been imprisoned in water. अष्टावक्र rescued him.
As per the Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad (3.5.1) कहोल questioned the sage Yājña-valkya in the court of the king जनक about ब्रह्मन् but was silenced by his brilliant answers.
